summary: One session revoke on the managing tenant now signs an administrator out of every managed tenant, which matters most when someone leaves.

new.title: One revoke reaches every managed tenant
new.text: When you revoke an administrator's sessions on the managing tenant, the Manager asks whether to revoke them in managed tenants too. Each tenant then does so without its own approval.

fixes.title: Revokes are reliable and safe
fixes.text: Each tenant carries out a revoke once, and removing the administrator right after no longer cancels it. Break-glass accounts are never revoked.
